violation_type.title: Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Toys Choking Hazard (26 TAC §746.2415(a)(4))
violation_type.short_title: Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Toys Choking Hazard
violation_type.typical_finding: There were several toy cars with small pieces or small tires that could cause a choking hazard in the infant room.    Note: These toys were removed from the infant room.  Corrected at inspection.

finding_variants.text: There were several toy cars with small pieces or small tires that could cause a choking hazard in the infant room.    Note: These toys were removed from the infant room.  Corrected at inspection.
An infant was observed wearing an amber necklace. This was corrected at inspection as staff removed the necklace from the child.
Toddler was observed to be wearing an Amber Teething Necklace which is a choking hazard.
A bottle filled with water gel beads did not have the cover secured posing a chocking hazard in the infant II classroom .
A child in  the 13-18 months classroom and a child in the 18-24 months old classroom were found using pacifier beads.   Note: Director removed beads immediately from the children.
